scan: Tout revient à montre que de dernier est π-accessible.
tex:
Tout revient à %%
montrer que ce%%
dernier est $\Pi$-accessible.
note: The print has two typing errors, 'montre' for 'montrer' and 'de' for 'ce'. The TeX silently corrects both.
The % comment swallows the end of line, so the edition prints 'cedernier' as one word.

scan: indexés par des ensemble d'indices préordonnés
note: The print reads 'ensemble' without the plural s (the word is overstruck in the typescript). The TeX silently corrects it to 'ensembles'.
The % comment plus TeX skipping the leading space of the next line make the edition print 'ensemblesd'indices' as one word.
The TeX uses the product operator \prod here instead of the letter \Pi used for the cardinal everywhere else, including the same formula.
